text:
Maria G.: Quick check before cutoff — planning to cut v0.24.0 at 11:00 PT. Can owners confirm changelog + security signoff?
Jia L.: I'm pushing the changelog now, will also bump package.json version. pinging @Kevin R. for auth doc updates.
Kevin R.: On it. I will add the auth cookie migration note. Also: did we land the SSO cookie config in infra? @Tanya M.?
Tanya M.: Not yet. There was a small lockfile conflict; I can finish the infra change and run a quick rotation by 10:40 PT.
Sam P.: I reviewed the alerting & secrets changes — only thing missing was an explicit secrets-rotation step in the release notes, adding that now.
Alex Q.: QA smoke plan: 30m focused regression on staging (routing, cache keys, SSO). Need the exact build tag to pick image.
Maria G.: build tag will be `v0.24.0-rc3` for canary, promote to `v0.24.0` if green.
Jia L.: changelog pushed in the docs repo, PR #4821. package.json bumped to 0.24.0-rc3 in release branch.
Kevin R.: Updated the auth doc and linked to changelog. Also left a note about cookie expiry semantics.
infra-sec-bot: Security review requested: ticket SEC-974 — reviewers: @Sam P., @Tanya M.
Sam P.: I can do security signoff unless infra finds a migration blocker. Doing a pass now.
deploy-bot: CI status: release-branch checks green — 7/7 ✅
Alex Q.: Will start QA at 10:45 PT on staging with `v0.24.0-rc3`. If canary looks good, we'll run promotion smoke then.
Jia L.: heads-up: one flaky test found in e2e routing, created PR #4826 to increase timeout.
Alex Q.: Saw that — rerunning the flaky suite after PR merge.
deploy-bot: PR #4826 merged by jia.l — staging rebuild queued (ci/build/1912000025).
Maria G.: If no major blockers from security/infra/QA, I'll cut tag at 11:00 PT and start canary at 11:10. Please react with :thumbsup: when ready.
Kevin R.: +1
Jia L.: +1
Sam P.: +1 — security signoff (added rotation note).
Tanya M.: infra changes applied, ran rotation smoke. No blockers from infra.
deploy-bot: Release tag `v0.24.0` created by maria.g — pipeline started: ci/release/1912000060.
infra-monitor: Canary metrics (10m): p50 latency +2ms, error rate 0.01% — healthy. No increased 5xx.
Alex Q.: Smoke passed on canary build, no regressions in targeted flows. Planning 15m steady-state check before full rollout.
Maria G.: Thanks everyone — cutting now and will open a short post-release note with links to PRs and the changelog.
Sam P.: Adding follow-ups: update rotation runbook with snippets and link: https://redwood.ai/docs/runbooks/rotation and I filed TECHDOC-214 for longer-term auth docs cleanup.
Jia L.: After promotion I'll merge the rc branch into main and bump the stable tag in the artifact registry.
Kevin R.: I'll add a short entry in the release notes about the cookie change and include the migration command: 
```
kubectl apply -f k8s/sso-cookie-config.yaml --namespace=infra
```
Maria G.: Awesome — closing this thread once release note is posted. If anyone sees post-cutover regressions, please ping #eng-oncall. :rocket:
